title: SmartAgri UGM Closes INAGRITECH 2025 Participation with 2,000 Visitors and Cross-Sector Collaboration Commitments
author: Athala Fawwaz
excerpt: SmartAgri UGM concluded its three-day participation at INAGRITECH 2025 (July 29–31, JIEXPO Kemayoran) with over 2,000 booth visitors from industry, academia, and international partners, affirming the center's growing role as a bridge between campus-based research and real-world agricultural innovation. The milestone underscores SmartAgri's commitment to advancing tropical precision agriculture through cross-sector collaboration and technology transfer.
body:
**Jakarta** — Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada concluded its participation in INAGRITECH 2025 with outstanding results. Over the three days of the event (July 29–31, 2025), the SmartAgri booth at Hall A3, A303-01, JIEXPO Kemayoran Jakarta recorded a total of more than **2,000 visitors**, comprising industry players, academics, students, and international partners.

The third and final day of the exhibition marked SmartAgri's consistent delivery of applied research and innovation messages relevant to the national agricultural sector. Despite being the last day, visitor enthusiasm showed no sign of waning — discussions, technology presentations, and collaboration explorations continued right up until closing time.

![](/brand/uploads/c2.webp) 

As a gesture of appreciation, SmartAgri expressed its gratitude and recognition to the sponsors who fully supported the success of this participation. The main sponsors were:

- **PT Cendekia Prima Inovasi**
- **Quantum Systems Indonesia – PT Quatindo Widjaya Adhirajasa**
- **PERTETA Jogja**

The support from these sponsors served as an important foundation in strengthening the research and collaboration ecosystem among stakeholders, as well as in driving the broader-scale transfer of campus-based agricultural technology.

_"This achievement is not just about the number of visitors — it's about how far campus research can build real connections with the industrial world and society. We are optimistic that the collaborations forged at INAGRITECH 2025 will continue into future agricultural technology initiatives,"_ said the SmartAgri team in their closing statement.

![](/brand/uploads/c3.webp)

SmartAgri UGM's participation in INAGRITECH 2025 reinforces the university's role as a driver of research-based innovation that is relevant and impactful for the development of tropical agriculture, both in the national and global context.
